{{Top|leg}}
The '''Dro ceremonial fountain''' was a family treasure of the [[House of Thul]]. It was located on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], it was sent to [[Dac/Legends|Mon Calamari]] to be repaired by the renowned artist [[Myrrack]], saving it from [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction]] by the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]].
